state.task: Select a finite causal next experiment toward olfactory navigation and perturbation recovery in a fly CNS plus prosthetic body. Advisory prioritization only.
state.completed_pair: Two 4-second arms, sham versus uniform bilateral virtual DM1=0.5 from 1 to 3 seconds; identical starting brain/body/weights/RNG, plasticity disabled. Both pass pre-stimulus rest criterion. ORN mean paired increase during stimulus L/R =0.2144/0.2171 normalized release, PN legacy +0.0552/+0.0655, DNb05 +0.000567/+0.000252. DNg100 L/R release difference exactly zero; raw forward command and clipped applied forward command zero for both entire runs. Applied yaw disabled prospectively. Body poses, velocities, contacts and forces identical between arms. Positive sensory propagation; no locomotor initiation. Initial state and one-interval sensory/motor lags independently verified. Incoming DNg100 synaptic current and target not persisted at 1 ms. Contact support and zero-command braking remain active; this is not free natural six-leg walking.
state.history: September direct DNg100 pulse already changed motor neurons without demonstrating natural walking. Earlier 12-second odor source run imposed forward speed0.2mm/s. A yaw relay saturated at -5deg/s despite weaker raw neural input and worsened orientation; raw physical replay improved but did not restore heading. Two 100-ms sensory tapes already fixed: virtual yaw2degrees versus same bilateral mean with isolated antisymmetric odor contrast. Previous neural contrast stopped at sham due CPU budget; common and virtual arms never run. New motor costs about1.45 wallseconds per simulated millisecond.
state.constraints: Do not adjust thresholds until desired behavior occurs. Never give target direction or source coordinates directly to controller. Preserve negative results. Maximum two prototypes per round; short predefined budgets. No further integrator optimization. No stage admission from rendering or a single diagnostic. Starting motion is a separate prerequisite from orientation and wind recovery.
state.codex_prior: First extract effective DNg100 law and prepared incoming input versus threshold without neural simulation; distinguish missing input from readout and mechanic rivals. Then a short directional-contrast neural test if justified, rather than another multi-second identical olfactory trial. Before closed-loop admission require calibrated independent body-interface response and signal sign/latency, then paired source and perturbation controls. No plasticity yet.

next_priority.instructions: Choose the most informative immediate priority on the supplied evidence, balancing relevance and cost; this is not scientific validation.

criteria.effective_input_law: Inspect stored operator and incoming drive/threshold of DNg100 and identify structural sensory recruitment failure; avoid inventing unrecorded currents.
criteria.directional_neural_contrast: Run the fixed short contrast between common and virtual bilateral input to measure signed DNb05 causal response, without claiming locomotion.
criteria.mechanical_calibration: Independently calibrate actual body response to nonzero interface commands, labeled a mechanical test and never olfactory proof.
criteria.plasticity: Enable plasticity to seek spontaneous locomotion in a longer stimulus run.
criteria.repeat_long: Repeat the same trial longer to see if motion eventually appears.

weakest_inference.instructions: Which potential inference from this pair most needs to be rejected or qualified?

criteria.clip_cause: The forward clipping suppressed a positive raw response, despite both raw and clipped values being zero.
criteria.biological_inactivity: DNg100 did not respond in this model, therefore real DNg100 or a real fly cannot initiate with odor.
criteria.no_sensory_propagation: No movement means the odor never propagated into the CNS despite measured ORN, PN and DNb05 changes.
criteria.stage_success: The pair proves stage4 navigation or stage5 recovery despite no movement or perturbation in its protocol.

stop_rule.instructions: Choose the most defensible next-round rule.

criteria.prospective_causal_gate: Fix inputs, signal sign/latency and effect scale, budget and stop rule before at most two bounded variants; a negative redirects the model layer, no retuning for PASS.
criteria.tune_until_motion: Increase gain or reduce DNg100 threshold until the fly starts, then count this as rescued stage4.
criteria.long_run_first: Spend another12seconds simulated before identifying whether any effective motor command exists.
